versions.short: The bill would update how the United States Foreign Service is run and staffed. It would cover several areas: how diplomats recruit and hire people, including from community colleges and veterans; training requirements for diplomats, such as crisis leadership, cybersecurity, consular work, and critical minerals; protections for diplomats who take outside assignments; promotion rules tied to joint duty and training; limits on favoritism in selecting outside members of hiring boards; cybersecurity and technology rules for overseas posts; and a pilot program to create a reserve corps of trained personnel for emergencies.
